title: JavaScript syntax diagnostic and hover tooltip
naturalLanguageTask: In Lynxtron Fiddle, introduce a JavaScript syntax error in the top-left editor, verify that a red wavy underline appears, hover that underline, and verify that its diagnostic tooltip says 'Expression expected.'. Restore the editor afterwards without saving.

setup.readyAssertion: Lynxtron Fiddle is the foreground window and its source code editors are visible

precondition: The foreground window is Lynxtron Fiddle and contains one or more source code editors

input.target: the top-left source code editor, inside its editable code area

observations.syntaxError: A red wavy underline is visibly marking the syntax error in the top-left editor containing 'const actOnceSyntaxProbe = ('
observations.hoverTarget: the red wavy underline on the syntax error in the top-left editor containing 'const actOnceSyntaxProbe = ('
observations.tooltipQuery: {visible: boolean, message: string | null}, determine whether a diagnostic tooltip is visible over or near the hovered red syntax-error underline, and transcribe its diagnostic message when visible
